newsitem.title: USA: Omega buys Vencor mortgage notes.
newsitem.headline: Omega buys Vencor mortgage notes.

text.p: Omega Healthcare Investors Inc said Monday it bought for $30.2 million a portfolio of mortgage notes from Vencor Inc.

The portfolio of notes was secured by first mortgage liens on nursing homes in Texas, New Mexico, California, Nevada, Utah, Wisconsin, Iowa and Tennessee. The 23 nursing homes contain 2,497 licensed beds.
The portfolio was developed over the last 10 years as Hillhaven Corp, a subsidiary of Vencor. The loans vary in size from $650,000 to $3.4 million and have an average remaining life of eight years.
The facilities are operated under leases to 12 different operators with Horizon Healthcare being the largest operator in the group.
Omega is a real estate investment trust investing in and providing financing to the long-term care industry.
